comparison.objective: Fill and remove a blood tube from a needle holder without moving the implanted needle; candidate installs a rack rail.
comparison.physical_skill: Stabilize one medical component continuously while piercing, filling, extracting, and placing a tube versus support and latch a long rail across separated posts.
comparison.success_condition: Requires needle displacement under 2 mm, uninterrupted holder support, stopper piercing, fill level, tube removal, and tray placement; candidate requires four-prong retention, rack-unit match, screws, and self-support.
comparison.reason: Both require preserving an initial engagement while manipulating another part, but the record tests stabilization during fluid collection rather than structural installation.
